title: Relative finite locally free locus on algebraic spaces commutes with arbitrary base change
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $p:X\to Y$ be locally of finite presentation, tested on etale scheme charts [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Use quasi-coherent modules on the small etale ringed sites [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite presentation (etale locally the cokernel of a map between finite rank free modules), flat over $Y$ (on etale scheme charts, each stalk is flat over the corresponding local ring of the base). Let $W(F)\subseteq|X|$ consist of points admitting an etale neighbourhood on which $F$ is isomorphic to $\mathcal O^{\oplus r}$ for a finite integer $r\geq0$. Then $W(F)$ is open. For every morphism $v:Y'\to Y$ of algebraic spaces over $S$, form $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projection $q:X'\to X$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]; then $W(q^*F)=|q|^{-1}(W(F))$. No flatness assumption on $p$ or $v$, no finite-presentation assumption on $v$, and no Noetherian assumption is imposed.

proof.text: For each $x\in W(F)$ choose its witnessing etale scheme neighbourhood $e:U\to X$ with $e^*F\simeq\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$. Every point in $|e|(|U|)$ has this same witness, so this image is contained in $W(F)$ and contains $x$. By [lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover] the point image of every etale scheme map is open. Thus $W(F)$ is the union of these open images and is open.

source.place: Tag 0CZT (lemma-finite-free-open), proof: Openness holds trivially; spaces topology made explicit.

proof.text: The hypotheses needed on $X'$ and $F'=q^*F$ persist. For local finite presentation of $p':X'\to Y'$, choose a surjective etale scheme chart $V\to Y$ and a surjective etale scheme chart $U\to X\times_YV$; by [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] the scheme map $U\to V$ is locally of finite presentation. Choose a surjective etale scheme chart $V'\to V\times_YY'$ and put $U'=U\times_VV'$, a scheme. By [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], $V\times_YY'\to Y'$ and $U'\to(X\times_YV)\times_VV'=X'\times_{Y'}V'$ are base changes of surjective etale maps, hence surjective etale, so $V'\to Y'$ and $U'\to X'\times_{Y'}V'$ are surjective etale charts. On affine pieces a presentation $B=A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(h_1,\ldots,h_m)$ becomes $B\otimes_AA'=A'[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(h'_1,\ldots,h'_m)$, so $U'\to V'$ is locally of finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-base-change-composition]; the other direction of [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] then gives the chartwise condition of [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties] for $p'$ on every chart pair. The module $F'$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-module-pullback-quasicoherent] and of finite presentation by the clause "Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation" of [lem-sfb-space-fp-module-limit-category] (its limit clauses are not used): a local presentation $\mathcal O^a\to\mathcal O^b\to F\to0$ pulls back to one of the same shape, since tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] is a left adjoint and $q^*\mathcal O_X=\mathcal O_{X'}$; this is the predicate of [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] with finite index sets. Finally [lem-sfb-space-pointwise-module-flat-base-change](1), at every $x'$, shows that $F'$ is flat over $Y'$. This uses no flatness of $p$ or $v$.

proof.text: Fix $x'\in|X'|$ and a field-valued representative $\xi':\operatorname{Spec}K\to X'$; put $\xi=q\xi'$, $\eta'=p'\xi'$ and $\eta=p\xi=v\eta'$. The fibre-product universal property [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers] gives $\alpha:X'\times_{Y',\eta'}\operatorname{Spec}K\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_{Y,\eta}\operatorname{Spec}K$. On test schemes it sends $((a,b),c)$ to $(a,c)$; the inverse sends $(a,c)$ to $((a,\eta'c),c)$. These inverse formulas also identify the two tautological points from $\xi'$ and $\xi$. The projections to $X$ agree under $\alpha$, so the pulled-back modules agree: the tensor reassociation $C\otimes_B(B\otimes_A N)\cong C\otimes_A N$, given by $c\otimes(b\otimes n)\mapsto cb\otimes n$ with inverse $c\otimes n\mapsto c\otimes(1\otimes n)$, gives their canonical identification from [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors].

source.place: Tag 0CZT (lemma-finite-free-open), comparison of the fibres; explicit common-field fibre identification underlying the appeal to Tag 05WY.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-fibre-flat-free-criterion] to $p,F,\xi$ and to $p',F',\xi'$, using step 2 for the latter hypotheses. It identifies $|q|(x')\in W(F)$ and $x'\in W(F')$ respectively with flatness of the two fibre modules over their own fibre spaces at the tautological points. Step 3 identifies these ringed spaces, modules and points; therefore the two flatness conditions are the same. Hence for every $x'$ one has $x'\in W(q^*F)\iff |q|(x')\in W(F)$, proving the required equality. The argument includes rank zero and imposes no further condition on $Y'\to Y$.
